the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: By the sheaf-differentials lemma, valid over a field with s, t locally of finite type, the sheaf of differentials of R to U is free. Over a field of characteristic zero, a locally finite type morphism whose sheaf of differentials is free is smooth, by Varieties, char-zero-differentials-free-smooth. Hence s, t : R to U are smooth. (source lines 1630-1636)
